bio.text: Kevin Kiley was first elected to the U.S. House in 2022 and represents California's 3rd District; he grew up in the district and graduated from Granite Bay High School.

He taught 10th-grade English at Manual Arts High School in Los Angeles, later worked as a lawyer and as a Deputy Attorney General for California, and served in the California State Assembly from 2016 to 2022.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Harvard University (2007), a master's in secondary education from Loyola Marymount University (2009) and a law degree from Yale Law School (2012).
Ballotpedia reports that Kiley announced on March 6, 2026 that he filed for re-election with no party affiliation; he is on the November 3, 2026 ballot in California's 6th District.
